0022600008.text: The Knicks have yet to play a 2026-27 game, while the Celtics are 0-1 after a loss, sitting 5th in the Atlantic, half a game back, and 15th in the East. New York won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 112-106 win in New York on April 9, 2026. Boston is without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness.
